# [STORY] As an operator, I want structured logging and metrics plus a local observability stack, so that service health is visible without live cloud infrastructure

## User Story
**As an** operator
**I want** structured logging and metrics plus a local observability stack
**So that** service health is visible without live cloud infrastructure

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a service handles a request, when it logs and emits metrics, then logs are structured JSON and metrics are scraped by the local Prometheus/ELK stack

## Notes
DoD Audit & Adversarial Review Verified (2026-08-03):
- All 11 DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md gates satisfied.
